notes: UAE Shopify storefront. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (general 'Allow: /'); direct HTTP fetch used throughout, no browser needed. Discovery: sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (full collection list, EN + ar/de/ru locales share the same entity ID range = identical catalog, no Arabic-only seasonal categories) plus the live homepage mega menu (Furniture, Flowers & Orchids, Artificial Trees, Plants & Succulents, Stems & Sprays, Home Decor, Lighting, Bedlinen & Towels, Tableware, Rugs & Carpets - no Christmas/Ramadan/Valentine nav item currently live, consistent with being off-season as of Sept 2026, but their collection pages remain indexed and live). Searched the full collections list for every discovery-vocabulary slug: Christmas, Halloween, Diwali/Deepavali, Valentine, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year, Eid, Ramadan, Holi, Rakhi/Raksha Bandhan, Navratri, Dussehra, Mother's/Father's Day, St. Patrick's, Black Friday - only Christmas, Ramadan and Valentine slugs exist; no Eid, Diwali, Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year, or Indian-festival categories found anywhere. FOUND (Christmas): /collections/christmas (hub, 471 products) itself features exactly 3 sub-collection cards - Artificial Christmas Arrangements (4), Christmas Baubles & Ornaments (433), Wreaths (26) - confirmed by inspecting the page's collection-card markup. Christmas Trees (9) is not a hub card but its product URLs were verified present inside the 471-count Christmas listing, confirming genuine Christmas association. Christmas Baubles (337) and Christmas Ornaments (96) are separate, currently-orphaned (not linked from the hub or nav) legacy PLPs whose exact sum (433) matches Christmas Baubles & Ornaments, so they are nested as children of that combined listing per the parent/subset grouping rule rather than double-counted. Christmas parent (471) is recorded as a grouping row (qty:null) since its own count is a near-total union of its children (9+4+433+26=472 vs displayed 471, off by 1 - normal live-catalog drift, not a data problem). Wreaths is generically named (not 'Christmas Wreaths') but its exact product URLs were verified inside the Christmas 471 listing, so it is kept as a Christmas child rather than excluded as a generic product type. FOUND (Valentine's Day): /collections/valentine (116 products) is a genuine curated Valentine collection (rose/flower arrangements, a wreath, succulents - Valentine-appropriate gifting items). EXCLUDED after investigation: Ramadan Edit (/collections/ramadan-edit, 235 products) and The Ramadan Edit (/collections/the-ramadan-edit, 1098 products) - despite the name, sampled product titles are generic, non-Ramadan decor (Ceramic Vase, Bowl, Flower Pot; one item is even titled 'Santa Tray') with no lanterns, crescents, Iftar tableware, or any Ramadan-specific product found - these are mislabeled bulk decor dumps, not genuine Ramadan categories, so no genuine Ramadan/Eid row exists on this site. Ramadan Sale (9028 products - effectively the whole catalog) and Christmas Sale (0 products, page literally reads 'No products found') are excluded as marketing/sale pages per the shared core and rules SS4/SS17 (Christmas Sale also drops for having 0 products).
